_source: HackPrinceton 2026 CoStar track quickstart ('One house, inside and out'), sections 1, 3 and 4, pasted 2026-11-14. Only the panoLocations query gained the model-level 'name' field, which the quickstart's Basics query uses.
model_check_query: query Basics($id: ID!) { model(id: $id) { id name visibility panoLocations { id } } }
pano_query: query Panos($id: ID!) { model(id: $id) { name panoLocations { id label position { x y z } skybox(resolution: "2k") { status children } } } }
